Strategic Sourcing AI & Automation Intern   

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. 
 
 Who We Are: 

 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

 Job Description: 
    
 Job Family Definition: 
 Students currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in areas such as Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Industrial Engineering, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Applies academic knowledge, analytical thinking, emerging technologies, and creative problem-solving to real business challenges. Collaborates with business and technical stakeholders to research, design, prototype, test, and improve solutions while developing practical professional experience.

 Management Level Definition: 
 Entry-level internship role that performs assigned work under the guidance of a supervisor or experienced team members. Contributes to project-based activities, develops practical knowledge of business processes and technologies, and builds professional skills through collaboration, analysis, experimentation, and delivery of defined project outcomes.

 Responsibilities: 
 
• Support the Strategic Sourcing organization through research, data analysis, process analysis, and project coordination. 
• Own or materially contribute to an AI, analytics, or automation project supporting Strategic Sourcing. 
• Collaborate with sourcing leaders, commodity managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand business challenges and define structured requirements. 
• Gather, organize, and analyze structured and unstructured information, including pricing records, contracts, supplier data, market intelligence, and other business documents. 
• Translate sourcing challenges into workflows, data requirements, solution concepts, and project deliverables. 
• Research, design, prototype, and test AI-enabled capabilities supporting negotiation preparation, supplier-risk identification, contract intelligence, and sourcing decision support. 
• Explore and apply technologies such as generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, workflow automation, and data visualization, where appropriate. 
• Develop dashboards, prototypes, user experiences, or decision-support tools that make sourcing information easier to access and use. 
• Test AI-generated outputs for accuracy, consistency, traceability, and business usefulness. 
• Document solution designs, data sources, assumptions, limitations, testing results, and opportunities for future development. 
• Participate in team meetings, project reviews, demonstrations, and periodic feedback sessions. 
• Present project results, potential business impact, and recommendations to Strategic Sourcing leadership. 
• Fulfill assigned tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner and deliver work against defined project milestones. 
• Follow company requirements for confidentiality, data protection, responsible AI use, and approved technology platforms when handling contracts, pricing, supplier information, personal data, or other business-sensitive content. 
 Education & Experience: 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Industrial Engineering, Finance, Economics, or a related field. 
• No prior professional experience required. 
• Previous internships, university projects, research, hackathons, analytics projects, or AI-related coursework are a plus. 
• Demonstrated interest in applying technology, analytics, and AI to solve real-world business problems is highly desirable. 
 Knowledge & Skills: 
 
• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills. 
• Ability to break down ambiguous business problems into actionable components. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
• Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
• Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and business processes. 
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across business and technical teams. 
• Strong attention to detail when working with financial, commercial, contractual, or supplier information. 
• Strong time-management skills and ability to deliver against defined project milestones. 
• Experience or coursework in one or more of the following is beneficial: 
• Generative AI and large language models. 
• Prompt engineering and AI workflow design. 
• Retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, document chunking, or embeddings. 
• Python, SQL, Power Query, or similar analytical tools. 
• Microsoft Power BI or other data-visualization platforms. 
• Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot Studio, or similar low-code/no-code development tools. 
• APIs, data integration, or basic application development. 
• Structured and unstructured data analysis. 
• Extracting and analyzing information from PDF, Word, and Excel files. Impact/Scope: 
 University students actively enrolled in an accredited college, university, or academic institution and pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant technical, analytical, business, or supply-chain discipline. The intern contributes to project-based initiatives that improve how Strategic Sourcing professionals access information, identify opportunities and risks, prepare for negotiations, and make commercial decisions.
 Depending on the assigned project, the work may help sourcing teams:

• Reduce manual effort required to prepare for supplier negotiations. 
• Surface historical pricing, commitments, and concessions more efficiently. 
• Identify emerging supplier and supply-chain risks earlier. 
• Locate and understand important contractual and commercial provisions faster. 
• Transform fragmented information into actionable sourcing intelligence. 
• Develop reusable AI-enabled approaches that can potentially be applied across additional commodities and sourcing workflows.  

 Accessibility 

 HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here .

 Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 

 What We Can Offer You: 

 Health & Wellbeing 
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
 
 Personal & Professional Development 
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
 
 Unconditional Inclusion 
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

 Let's Stay Connected: 

 Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

#interns

Aidez-nous à redéfinir le service à la clientèle à l’ère de l’IA.
 La plupart des entreprises gèrent encore leur soutien avec des systèmes de billetterie conçus en 2007, auxquels on a greffé l’IA après coup.
 Botpress est la plateforme d’agents IA de niveau entreprise pour le service à la clientèle, conçue dans le sens inverse.
 Le travail à venir est ambitieux. L’occasion est rare. Nous abordons la croissance de façon réfléchie : axée sur le produit, efficace sur le plan du capital et très ciblée.
 Si vous voulez bâtir la plateforme de service à la clientèle de l’ère de l’IA, nous recherchons les meilleurs talents pour se joindre à nous.
 À propos du poste 
 Nous recherchons un(e) Software Developer Intern pour rejoindre notre équipe à temps plein pour l'été 2026.
 En tant que membre de l’équipe Engineering chez Botpress, vous travaillerez sur des problématiques réelles rencontrées par nos clients en utilisant le code. Vous contribuerez à des projets à fort impact, collaborerez avec différentes équipes et participerez à faire évoluer ce qui fonctionne déjà à grande échelle.
 Si vous êtes proactif(ve), débrouillard(e) et enthousiaste à l’idée d’utiliser la technologie (y compris la création occasionnelle de contenu technique) pour faire avancer les choses dans un environnement d’IA conversationnelle en constante évolution, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous.
 
 Responsabilités 
 
• Développer et maintenir des fonctionnalités ayant un impact direct sur les clients en utilisant React et Node.js (TypeScript) 
• Développer et maintenir des intégrations reliant Botpress à des systèmes externes en utilisant React et Node.js (TypeScript) 
• Rédiger des tests unitaires et des tests end-to-end pour des fonctionnalités critiques 
• Mettre en place des outils de tracking et de monitoring afin de suivre les parcours utilisateurs 
• Contribuer à la documentation produit

• Passionné(e) par l’apprentissage continu, l’expérimentation et l’exploration des possibilités offertes par les nouvelles technologies 
• Adopte une attitude proactive (« can-do ») face aux défis et s’épanouit dans des environnements dynamiques et rapides 
• Actuellement en cours d’études en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente dans un établissement d’enseignement basé au Québec 
• Intérêt pour les agents d’IA et les grands modèles de langage (LLM) 
• Une expérience avec les chatbots, l’IA ou des technologies connexes est un atout 
• Excellentes compétences en communication, à l’oral comme à l’écrit 
• Expérience avec TypeScript, Node.js et React
 À propos de Botpress
 Botpress a conclu une ronde de financement de série B de 25 millions de dollars en 2025. Nous bâtissons la plateforme d’agents IA de niveau entreprise pour le service à la clientèle, non pas en ajoutant de l’IA à une vieille infrastructure, mais en misant sur l’IA dès le premier jour.
 En tant que start-up en forte croissance, nous formons une équipe allégée et innovante qui s’appuie sur l’IA pour maximiser son impact. Chez Botpress, chacun est propriétaire et apporte sa perspective et ses talents uniques. Nous recrutons délibérément des personnes motivées, passionnées, talentueuses et avides d’apprendre et de progresser tout au long de leur carrière.
 Nous travaillons entièrement au bureau, dans une culture qui valorise à la fois la rigueur technique et une ambition commune.
 Vous ferez partie d’une équipe qui ne se contente pas de s’adapter à la révolution de l’IA, mais qui la mène. Se joindre à nous, c’est changer la façon dont des millions de clients interagissent avec les entreprises avec lesquelles ils font affaire, et bâtir la plateforme qui définira la prochaine ère du service à la clientèle.

• Travaillez au sein de l’une des start-ups en IA à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada 
• Collaborez avec une équipe talentueuse et passionnée 
• 2 semaines de vacances 
• Frigo et garde-manger entièrement garnis — nous prenons les collations très au sérieux 
• Votre propre bureau — pas de système de « hot desk » 
• Une vie de bureau dynamique, incluant des activités sociales hebdomadaires
fit_why: React/TypeScript/Node full-stack intern, matches his core stack well

jd:
Help redefine customer support for the AI era. 
 Most companies are running support on ticketing systems built in 2007, with AI bolted on as an afterthought.
 Botpress is the enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer support — built the other way around.
 The work ahead is ambitious. The opportunity is rare. We take a deliberate approach to growth: product-led, capital-efficient, and highly focused.
 If you want to build the customer support platform for the AI era, we’re looking for top talent to join us.
 About the Role
 We’re looking for a Software Developer Intern to join our team full-time during the Winter 2025 semester. As part of the Engineering team at Botpress, you’ll focus on solving real problems for our clients using code. You’ll work on high-impact projects, collaborate across functions, and help scale what works. If you’re proactive, resourceful, and excited about using technology (including occasional technical content) to make things happen in the fast-moving world of conversational AI, we’d love to hear from you.
 Responsibilities
 
• Develop and maintain customer-impacting features using React & Node.js (Typescript) 
• Develop and maintain integrations connecting Botpress to external systems using React & Node.js (Typescript) 
• Write unit and end-to-end tests for mission-critical features 
• Add tracking and monitoring to capture user journeys 
• Contribute to product documentation

• You have a relentless passion for learning, experimenting, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with new technologies. 
• You bring a “can-do” mindset to every challenge and thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments. 
• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience in a Quebec-based learning institution. 
• Interest in the AI agent and large language model (LLM) space. 
• Experience with chatbots, AI, or related technologies is a plus. 
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. 
• Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React
 About Botpress
 Botpress raised a $25 million Series B round in 2025. We’re building the enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer support — not by adding AI to old infrastructure, but by building AI-first from day one.
 As a fast-growing start-up, we run a lean and innovative ship that leans on AI for maximum business impact. At Botpress, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective and talents. We intentionally hire individuals who are eager, passionate, talented, and hungry to learn and grow throughout their career.
 We operate fully in-office, with a culture that values both technical rigor and shared ambition.
 You’ll be on a team that’s not just adapting to the AI revolution, but leading it. Joining our team means changing how millions of customers interact with the companies they do business with — and building the platform that defines the next era of customer support.

• Work at one of Canada’s fastest-growing AI start-ups 
• Work with a talented and passionate team 
• 2 weeks of vacation 
• Fully-stocked fridge and cupboard – we take snacks seriously  
• Your own desk – no ‘hot-desk’-style sign-up systems 
• A vibrant office community, including weekly socials
fit_why: React, TypeScript, Node.js core stack plus AI/LLM interest match well
